title: Turning down Ella Fitzgerald
summary: Albert regrets declining Ella Fitzgerald's help via Mo Gale at the Savoy and not taking her into his band while playing Buffalo.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: And I told her I appreciated her doing what she did for me, but I didn't think I was ready for that.

Which is another mistake. Another mistake is not taking Ella Fitzgerald in my band when I was playing at the Vendo. In New York? That's in New York? Oh, this was in New York, but not New York City. This was in Buffalo, New York. I was playing at the Vendo and at the Buffalo in Buffalo, New York. But now when Ella had Gale to meet me, this was in New York City at the Savoy Ballroom. See, Ella had already gotten to be a pretty established performer, and by being close friends, she was going to do me a big favor, which it was. And I'm sorry that I didn't accept it in those days. I possibly would have gone a lot further than I did. Well, some of the bookers were national. Well, that's why we were going ahead and we were talking about these bookers. Yeah. What do you start to ask me?
